headline: Shopping cart regulations ordinance, marijuana retail chapter amendment, and a Fisheries Commission appointment.
summary: The committee will consider CC#2026-017 (Benson) adding shopping cart regulations to GCO Chapter 14, and a memo proposing an amendment to Chapter 28 on Marijuana Retail Establishments. A new appointment to the Fisheries Commission will also be discussed.
items: New appointment: Angela Sanfilippo to Fisheries Commission, term to expire 2/15/2029

CC#2026-017 (Benson): Amend GCO Ch. 14 'Offenses and Miscellaneous Provisions' by adding new Article IV 'Shopping Cart Regulations,' including Sec. 14-46 'Definitions,' Sec. 14-47 'Identification of shopping carts,' Sec. 14-48 'Shopping carts to be confined to premises,' Sec. 14-49 'Enforcement' (continued from September 14, 2026)
Memorandum from General Counsel proposing an amendment to Chapter 28 Marijuana Retail Establishments
location: Harbormaster's Conference Room, 19 Harbor Loop #1, Gloucester, MA 01930
